name: kogan-mcp
description: Kogan Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders.

platform_mcp_kogan_seller_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_SELLER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kogan_seller_token.description: SellerToken (API key) issued by your Kogan Marketplace account manager after the marketplace application is approved (UAT and production keys differ); sent as the SellerToken header.

platform_mcp_kogan_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_kogan_seller_id.description: SellerID (your Kogan marketplace account name) issued with the token; sent as the SellerID header.

platform_mcp_kogan_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_API_HOST
platform_mcp_kogan_api_host.description: nimda.kogan.com for production, or nimda-marketplace.aws.kgn.io for the UAT test environment; calls go to https://<api_host>/api/marketplace/v2/...

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one of your products ({status, body: {next, previous, results[]}}) to verify SellerToken/SellerID.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /products/ [{product_sku, product_title, product_description, stock}] updates only the keys sent ('only send the keys that have changed'); `listing_id` is your product SKU. The change is LIVE on kogan.com once processed. Asynchronous: status is AsyncResponsePending/Complete/CompleteWithErrors/Failed and raw.pending_url gives the result. `price` is NOT applied: prices live in offer_data keyed by store currency (AUD/NZD) and each entry also requires handling_days.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: POST /products/stockprice/ [{product_sku, stock}] sets the stock of one product by SKU (`sku` is required; listing_id is not used). Stock 0 marks the listing sold out (removed automatically after 7 days). Asynchronous; see raw.pending_url.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: POST /products/status/ {product_sku, enabled: false} disables the product and removes the listing from the website immediately (reversible with enabled: true). `listing_id` is your product SKU. Kogan must grant this API to your account first (marketplace-support@kogan.com.au); otherwise 403.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /orders/?status&startDateUTC&limit. `status` is REQUIRED by Kogan: ReleasedForShipment (paid, awaiting dispatch), Pending, AcknowledgedBySeller, PartiallyShipped, Shipped or Canceled; for Shipped/PartiallyShipped/Canceled the date range is at most 15 days. The endpoint has no offset/cursor, so there is no second page (raise `limit` instead). Items, addresses and dispatched items are in raw.
